cc:Work.dc:title: Lake height-area-volume curve
cc:Work.dc:description: Three samples have areas 1, 2, 1 km² and elevations 100, 101, 103 m, with a 104 m sill. The worked annual balance closes at 101 m and 40 percent of terminal sample B: wet area 1.8 km², storage 1 million m³, capacity 11 million m³.
